_readme: Authored content for Batch ksadasd (rule 18: content as data, never ad-hoc writes). One entry per sighted invoice.
Each coding_note restates what the invoice face prints for that document (job or quote number, site, contract, order,
contact, completion or visit date and the priced lines) and states whether the printed PK equals the PK charged on the register.
nature_category and theme_v3 are the per-invoice categories (Theme_Map v2 and Theme_Map_v3) read from the printed scope words,
because T & H Levai and Weis Contractors each print several kinds of work under one contract and a vendor-level category would misstate them.
No amount here is inferred: every figure is the printed one, and the corpus gates GREEN with all 68 documents at TIE.
